mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. We are looking at a clear and cool morning at 56 degrees, which is perfect for visiting the Military Ridge State Trail. The moon is currently in its First Quarter phase.

City Hall reminds residents that VHAT serves as our local cable channel for government meetings and community news. Additionally, please note that residential vehicle parking must be at least five feet from property lines, and composting organic waste is encouraged through the free Food Scrap Stop program located at Badger Prairie County Park.

We have a packed schedule today. You can enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, don't miss the free Concerts in the Park at Century School Park or trivia at Hop Haus.

In a report covering July 13 through July 20, we see that on July 14, officers performed a traffic stop where a driver was cited for possession of marijuana and drug paraphernalia, and a passenger was cited for not wearing a seat belt.
Today is the perfect time to enjoy a Mint Explosion flavor of the day. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, it will be Really Reese's.
